Taimodels Releases Billund Airport for MSFS 2020/2024

Danish airport is home to both cargo and passenger operations.

Reading time: 1 minutes
MSFS MSFS 2024
Comments (6)
Posted: 13-Sep-2026 @ 09:06z
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:14
Instaread

Denmark’s Billund International Airport (ICAO: EKBI) is the latest airport by developer Taimodels to release for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024.

The single runway airport in the centre of Denmark hosts a variety of regional and international carriers, as well as being a busy cargo hub. The scenery by Taimodels recreates the airport with hand-made, detailed PBR ground markings and textures based on the latest airport layout. Additionally, the airport includes detailed terminal interiors, cargo buildings, and airport structures using MSFS PBR materials.

With ILS and RNP approaches to both ends of the 3101m runway, the challenging weather conditions can make Billund a tricky place to fly into at certain times of the year. Passengers board their aircraft via jetbridge walkways or they are driven to and from 16 remote parking areas.

You can purchase a copy of Taimodels Billund Airport for MSFS 2020/2024 at the Contrail store for €18,49.

Features

  • Hand-made, detailed PBR ground markings and textures based on the latest airport layout
  • Detailed terminal interiors Hand-made, realistic terminals, cargo buildings, and airport structures using MSFS PBR materials
  • Realistic airport lighting, taxiways, and aprons
  • Optimized performance for most system configurations Animated screens
  • Custom DEM
  • GSX profiles
